decisions.decision: Transactions tab layout = sketch 020-B · Filter rail; page at GeniusBreakpoints.xl (1280) with GWPageHeader; rail and list each in a DashboardScrollContainer
decisions.rationale: The ⋯ overflow menu exists only because a 376px panel cannot show nine filters. A page can, so the rail IS that menu unrolled — the width buys something actionable instead of a gap between a hash and a number. The dashboard panel keeps its chips.

decisions.decision: Active rail row = sketch 022-B2 · underline only — w700 textPrimary label NEVER recoloured, 2px gradient rule beneath, glyph untouched
decisions.rationale: Jakub: 'to jest obecny standard na navigation bar i to powinnismy miec'. Verified: responsive_overlay.dart:349 paints the active tab with brandCta and does NOT gradient its label. Sketch 020's brand-fill background was invented and rejected; a gradient count was rejected because filterCounts() is computed over the UNFILTERED list so the numbers never move; a gradient wash was rejected at ~1.3:1 against the card (WCAG 1.4.11 wants 3:1) and because it collides with the hover fill.

decisions.decision: Empty state anchored by a RULE, not an offset: ConstrainedBox(maxHeight: 480) under Alignment.topCenter
decisions.rationale: In a short panel it behaves exactly as before, so nothing regresses where the layout was already fine; in a 1400px panel the icon settles at 192px instead of 652. Shared component — Assets and Markets get the same fix.

decisions.decision: Amounts print the real number in every case; the status carries the truth. The 'Not charged' value line is LOAD-BEARING and must not be removed
decisions.rationale: Jakub overruled the recommendation to drop the minus sign on a failed row. The override is safe ONLY because the value line disambiguates: the row then states 0.75 ETH · Not charged · Failed. Without that line a full-weight − 0.75 ETH asserts a balance change that never happened.

decisions.decision: 37639d5 was an INCOMPLETE freeze fix; seven AutoSizeText call sites converted to fixed styles with ellipsis
decisions.rationale: It quantised a height-derived font size but left AutoSizeText free to re-fit on WIDTH, which a drag varies just as continuously. The app froze again the same afternoon with SkLRUCache<ParagraphCacheKey>::remove at 1580 samples. The original guard tested a pure function and never touched a widget — it tested the fix, not the bug. test/freeze_rule_test.dart now scans dashboard-reachable sources and fails with a file:line.
